note: NGPC wildlife management area on 50-acre Grove Lake, 2 mi north of Royal (86502 Grove Lake Rd), with a trout hatchery. Primitive camping is allowed in three areas off the gravel road along the west side of the lake; no hookups, no fee. A 2023 camper found almost no amenities (one outhouse, two boat docks) and tight turnarounds for a large motorhome. Directories list tables, fire pits, hydrants and vault toilets. Little or no cell service. --Claude
